title: Filter, validate and clean the orders
prompt: Some rows in the export can't go into a sales report: a status nobody recognises, a negative total, an order dated outside the year. Write `clean_orders(orders)`. It starts from your `order_view(orders)` and keeps only the orders that pass every check below.
rules: `status` is one of `placed`, `paid`, `shipped`, `delivered`, `cancelled`, `refunded`, written exactly like that.
`order_total` is 0 or more. A missing or negative total fails.
`order_date` is in 2026: on or after 2026-01-01 and before 2027-01-01. A missing date fails.
Return `order_view`'s columns. Duplicate rows stay for now; a later step removes them.
hints: Call `order_view(orders)` first and filter what it returns, so the columns are already right.
Three checks, joined with `&`, each in parentheses. The status check is one `isin(...)`.
The date needs two comparisons: `>= "2026-01-01"` and `< "2027-01-01"`. Missing values fail any comparison on their own.
